headline: India's Aviation Regulator Issues Show-Cause Notice to SpiceJet
summary: The DGCA issued a show-cause notice to SpiceJet citing grounded aircraft, flight schedule non-compliance, flight disruptions, and unpaid regulatory penalties.
why: SpiceJet is a listed Indian low-cost carrier whose operational reliability and financial solvency are closely monitored by aviation authorities.

impacts.name: SpiceJet Ltd
impacts.why: Regulatory scrutiny over grounded fleets and unpaid penalties threatens flight operations and financial stability.
